title: Agent 技能包与工具链集中爆发
opening: 今天榜单几乎被 Agent 技能包和配套工具占满，从安全审计到开发方法论都在往 Claude Code 这类宿主里塞。最扎眼的是 obra/superpowers 和 elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter，前者把完整开发流程拆成可组合技能，后者直接打包 85 个漏洞狩猎技能和 681 条披露报告模式。

projects.problem: 它把方法论、Web 应用狩猎、企业身份与基础设施攻击矩阵分层堆叠，并强调保持授权范围。适合授权红队和 Bug Bounty 场景，但技能数量庞大，实际效果取决于使用者能否正确编排和验证。

projects.name: obra/superpowers
projects.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Superpowers Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. Table of Contents - How it works - Commercial Services - Getting Started - Claude Code - Antigravity - Codex App - Codex CLI - Cursor - Devin CLI - Factory Droid - Gemini CLI - GitHub Copilot CLI - Grok Build CLI - Kimi Code - OpenCode - Pi - Qwen Code - Hermes Agent - Muse - The Basic Workflow - When Something Goes Wrong - Community - What's Inside - Philosophy - Contributing - Updating - License - Visual companion telemetry How it works It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. projects.summary: 一套让编码 Agent 先追问需求、再拆规格、最后按计划写代码的完整开发方法论。
projects.problem: 它不急着让 Agent 写代码，而是先逼出规格、分块确认设计，再生成连“没品味的初级工程师”都能执行的实现计划。适合想约束 Agent 随意发挥的团队，但流程偏重，小任务可能显得繁琐。

projects.name: jingyaogong/minimind
projects.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
projects.readmeExcerpt: "大道至简" 中文 | English * 此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。 * MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。 * 项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。 * MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 MiniMind-V、多模态 Omni 模型 MiniMind-O、扩散语言模型（MiniMind-dLM）、线性模型（MiniMind-Linear），详见 Discussion。 * 项目所有核心算法代码均从 0 使用 PyTorch 原生实现，不依赖第三方库提供的高层抽象接口。 * 这不仅是一个大语言模型全阶段开源复现项目，也是一套面向 LLM 入门与实践的教程。 * 希望此项目能为更多人提供一个可复现、可理解、可扩展的起点，一起感受创造的乐趣，并推动更广泛 AI 社区的进步。 > 注：本项目基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源，完全免费。“2 小时” 指 SFT 阶段在单张 NVIDIA 3090 上跑完 `1 epoch` 的实测耗时，“3 块钱” 指对应时段的 GPU 租用成本。 🔗 在线体验 | 🔗 视频介绍 ❤️ 赞助 MiniMind × Infistar.cc ：Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek等200+模型一个Key搞定，低至官方0.1折（省99%），100%官方纯血可验真，千条线路自动切换。通过 专属链接 注册即送¥5。 关于赞助与合作 MiniMind 以 Apache 2.0 协议完全开源、永久免费。赞助完全自愿，不换取任何特权，也不影响项目使用。感谢每一位支持者，让这个业余时间维护的项目得以持续。 赞助方式包括按月占位，或直接赞助 GPU 服务器（算力可能用于项目相关或不相关的研究性探索）。 如有意向，欢迎通过 邮件 联系。 📌 项目介绍 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的出现，引发了全球范围内对 AI 的空前关注。无论是 ChatGPT、DeepSeek 还是 Qwen，都以惊艳的效果让人真切感受到这场技术浪潮的冲击力。然而，动辄数百亿参数的模型规模，使得它们对个人设备而言不仅难以训练，甚至连部署都显得遥不可及。打开大模型的“黑盒子”，真正去理解其内部运作机制，本应是一件令人心潮澎湃的事。遗憾的是，绝大多数探索最终都止
projects.summary: 用 3 块钱 GPU 租用成本和 2 小时，从零训出一个 64M 的超小语言模型。
projects.problem: 项目把预训练、SFT、LoRA、DPO、PPO/GRPO 等全链路代码用原生 PyTorch 从零实现，不依赖高层抽象，还扩展到视觉和多模态变体。适合想亲手拆开 LLM 黑盒的人，但 64M 规模离实用产品很远。

projects.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
projects.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
projects.readmeExcerpt: **🔥 Firecrawl** **Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥** You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three. - **Firecrawl Local.** Run Firecrawl on your own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown, plugs into your AI agent as an MCP server and serves the Firecrawl API on localhost. - **Firecrawl Cloud.** Use the hosted service at firecrawl.dev for everything Local does at scale with nothing to run, plus search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria for far more knowledge than scraping alone. - **Self-hosting.** Deploy the full Firecrawl server from `apps/api` with its own queues, workers and databases on your own infrastructure. _Pst. Hey, you, join our stargazers :)_ Firecrawl Local Firecrawl Local scrapes, crawls and maps from your own machine without a database, queue or container, and it reaches Firecrawl Cloud when your AI agents need search or Alexandria. projects.summary: 把网站抓成干净 Markdown 的知识基础设施，现在还能以单二进制在本地跑并充当 MCP 服务器。
projects.problem: Firecrawl Local 不需要数据库、队列或容器，适合给 Agent 喂网页内容；云端版则额外提供搜索和 550+ 数据提供商。自托管全栈需要自己维护队列、worker 和数据库，运维成本不低。

projects.name: nginx/nginx
projects.description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
projects.readmeExcerpt: NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache. NGINX is free and open source software, distributed under the terms of a simplified 2-clause BSD-like license. Enterprise distributions, commercial support and training are available from F5, Inc. > [!IMPORTANT] > The goal of this README is to provide a basic, structured introduction to NGINX for novice users. Please refer to the full NGINX documentation for detailed information on installing, building, configuring, debugging, and more. These documentation pages also contain a more detailed Beginners Guide, How-Tos, Development guide, and a complete module and directive reference. Table of contents - How it works - Modules - Configurations - Runtime - Downloading and installing - Stable and Mainline binaries - Linux binary installation process - FreeBSD installation process - Windows executables - Dynamic modules - Getting started with NGINX - Installing SSL certificates and enabling TLS encryption - Load Balancing - Rate limiting - Content caching - Building from source - Installing dependencies - Cloning the NGINX GitH
projects.summary: NGINX 官方开源仓库，Web 服务器、负载均衡、反向代理和内容缓存的老牌底座。
projects.problem: README 面向新手梳理了模块、配置、运行时和安装流程，也覆盖 TLS、限流、缓存等常见场景。它出现在趋势榜上更多是基础设施工位的日常存在，而非新变化。
